title: Face on a model source with through-holes lifts over the holes and is refused with 16 'cuts past the finish surface' findings

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

A Face operation with a **model** source and Cut Z = top_of_model (z 15) is refused at the post with 16 blocking findings `move N cuts past the finish surface`. Nothing in the part is above z 15, so one flat pass at z 15 cannot touch it. The QA run saw the path lift over each of the 4 through-holes (rapids around them in the render); the 16 findings come in pairs on those moves (2, 9, 12, 19, 22, 29, ...). The same op with `source: "stock"` is clean and posts.

## Expected

A flat pass at z 15 over the whole stock top (through-holes below the cut plane play no part), clean verify.

## Repro (MCP)

**Part (p01-flange):** 6061 plate 100 x 60 x 10 mm centred on the origin (z 0..10), a 60 x 30 x 5 mm island on top (z 10..15, R5 corners) with a 1 x 45 deg chamfer on its top edges, 4 x dia 6 through holes at (+-42, +-22), a 10 mm wide x 3 mm deep slot across the +X end (x 35..45, floor z 7). Stock: box fitted to the model with +2 mm on top (100 x 60 x 17, z 0..17). WCS G54 at the stock's min-X min-Y top corner, world (-50, -30, 17). Machine Tormach 770MX, post Tormach PathPilot.

`add_tool {catalog: "EM-1000-4FL"}`; `add_operation {kind: "Face", tool: "EM-1000-4FL", source: "flange", params: {cut_z: {reference: "top_of_model", offset: 0}}}`; `generate`; `verify`.

## Evidence (upstream main abe24ff09)

verify: 16 findings, all `blocks_post: true`, moves 2, 9, 12, 19, 22, 29, 32, 39, 62, 69, 72, 79, 82, 89, 92, 99: `move N cuts past the finish surface`. With `source: "stock"`: no finding.

Either the hole lift dips below z 15 on its way down (a real gouge in the generated path, caught) or the finding is false; the fix should say which. P3: verify blocks it and the stock source is a workaround, but the user is told the part gouges.

Found by the QA swarm (SolidCraft v0.44.1 + CamCraft v0.23.0, part p01-flange). Re-checked on upstream main abe24ff09.

**Done means:** Face on a model source above through-holes posts one flat pass with no lifts and no findings; a test pins it on a plate with through-holes below the cut plane.
